anomalies.description: A man in a dark suit (blond hair) engages in a violent physical fight inside an elevator with two other men, involving punches, throws, and grappling; one opponent is thrown to the floor and another is lifted and slammed.
Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat inside an elevator; one man (blond hair) strikes and throws the other (dark hair) to the floor.
The fight resumes with rapid exchanges: the blond man grabs and lifts the dark-haired man, followed by a series of strikes and grappling movements.

Two men engage in a close-quarters physical fight inside an elevator; one with blond hair (attacker) delivers multiple strikes and throws the other man (in white shirt and tie) against the wall and floor.
The blond man continues to assault the downed opponent on the elevator floor, stepping on or pressing down on him while he is incapacitated and unable to defend himself.
The blond man stands up and assumes a ready stance, possibly preparing for further confrontation; the other man remains on the floor out of frame, suggesting the fight has paused but not concluded.
